[TODO:de] Hide the people in the dunes

hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Six hundred chariots can find you.
Only the Lord can save you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Trust the Lord and keep moving

army_charges.text:

[TODO:de] Run with them toward the cliffs

run_consequence.text:

The Lord will fight for you.

people_panic.text:
[TODO:de] The people cry out, trembling.
"Were there no graves in Egypt?"

[TODO:de] Surrender the people to Pharaoh
[TODO:de] Speak peace: stand and see Him

curse_consequence.text:

Lead them with His promise.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Speak peace: stand and see Him

surrender_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Never Back to Chains
surrender_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He did not free you to bind you.
Stand and trust His hand.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Speak peace: stand and see Him

moses_prays.title: [TODO:de] A Cry to Heaven
moses_prays.text:
[TODO:de] You stand at the water's edge.
Only the Lord can open this.

[TODO:de] Lift your staff over the sea
[TODO:de] Wait silently for some other sign

boats_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He needs no wood, no sails.
His breath is enough.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lift your staff over the sea

wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] "Why do you cry to me? Go forward."

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lift your staff over the sea

sea_parts.text:
[TODO:de] A great wind splits the sea in two.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Send the people across at once
[TODO:de] Stand back and only watch
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] It opened so you could go.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Send the people across at once

crossing.text:

Israel walks the dry path.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Boast of your power before them

boast_consequence.text:

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lead them toward the far shore
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You bow your head and walk.

far_shore.text:
[TODO:de] Israel stands safe. Behind you,
chariots crash into the corridor.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Mock the drowning soldiers

choices.text: [TODO:de] Run back to fight them yourself
[TODO:de] Stretch your hand back over the sea

mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His judgment is heavy and just.
Receive it with awe.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stretch your hand back over the sea

fight_consequence.title: [TODO:de] He Fights for You
fight_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Do not lift a sword tonight.
Lift only your hand at His word.

sea_closes.text:

Not one chariot rises again.

ending.text:
